primary_early_symptom: Small brown circular spots with faint concentric rings on bottom leaves
favorable_weather_condition: Frequent warm showers alternating with dry sunny periods
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Trichoderma viride foliar spray (2.5 kg/ha) + Neem oil 1500 ppm
preventive_cultural_measures: Mulch soil with straw to prevent soil splash; practice 3-year crop rotation

primary_early_symptom: Water-soaked dark lesions with pale green margins and white underside downy growth
favorable_weather_condition: Cool foggy mornings with prolonged relative humidity above 90%
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Copper hydroxide 53.8% DF + Bacillus amyloliquefaciens
preventive_cultural_measures: Destroy cull piles; avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; space plants for airflow

primary_early_symptom: Tiny angular dark greasy spots with yellow halo on leaflets
favorable_weather_condition: Driving rains and heavy morning dew at elevated temperatures
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Bacillus subtilis QST 713 formulation + Copper octanoate
preventive_cultural_measures: Use certified pathogen-free seeds; dip nursery roots in hot water; sanitize farm tools

primary_early_symptom: Upward cupping of leaf margins, severe stunted growth, pale chlorosis
favorable_weather_condition: Dry hot weather promoting Whitefly vector (Bemisia tabaci) proliferation
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Yellow sticky traps (25/acre) + Beauveria bassiana (1.5 kg/ha)
preventive_cultural_measures: Erect 50-mesh insect-proof nylon nettings around nurseries; eliminate volunteer solanaceous weeds

primary_early_symptom: Vibrant uniform green foliage, no chlorosis, vigorous turgid stems
favorable_weather_condition: Balanced seasonal climate with good diurnal range
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Compost tea + Seaweed extract bio-stimulant as foliar tonic
preventive_cultural_measures: Ensure balanced NPK fertilization (120:60:60); maintain consistent soil moisture

primary_early_symptom: Target-spot necrotic lesions primarily on senescing lower foliage
favorable_weather_condition: Warm weather with intermittent rainstorms and moisture stress
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Pseudomonas fluorescens (1 kg/acre) + Potassium silicate
preventive_cultural_measures: Provide adequate potassium nutrition; destroy infected foliage 10 days before vine killing

primary_early_symptom: Rapidly expanding water-soaked purplish-brown lesions surrounded by chlorotic halo
favorable_weather_condition: Consecutive days with temperature 15-20 C and RH > 90% (Smith Periods)
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Bordeaux Mixture (1:1:100) preventive spray
preventive_cultural_measures: Hill up soil around rows to protect tubers; destroy diseased potato haulms before harvest

primary_early_symptom: Inky black slimy rot at the stem base, stunting, upper leaf wilting
favorable_weather_condition: Waterlogged poorly drained soils following heavy cloudbursts
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Streptomyces lydicus WYEC 108 biocontrol drench
chemical_control_treatment: Copper Hydroxide 77% WP (Soil drench around collar)
preventive_cultural_measures: Plant certified seed tubers whole; avoid cutting tubers in humid conditions; improve drainage

primary_early_symptom: Velvety olive-green spots on young unfolding leaves turning dark brown
favorable_weather_condition: Extended leaf wetness duration exceeding 9 hours during petal fall
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Sulfur 80% WDG (bio-compatible) + Horticultural oil
preventive_cultural_measures: Shred fallen autumn leaves with flail mower; prune orchard canopy to maximize solar penetration

primary_early_symptom: Small reddish-purple specks expanding into frog-eye circular lesions
favorable_weather_condition: Warm overcast weather following mechanical hail damage
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Potassium bicarbonate + Serenade ASO (Bacillus strain)
preventive_cultural_measures: Prune out mummified fruit and dead twig cankers; treat pruning wounds with bio-sealant

primary_early_symptom: Bright orange-yellow circular spots with tiny dark exudating pycnia
favorable_weather_condition: Spring rains coinciding with galls discharging spores on nearby red cedar
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Neem extract (Azadirachtin) + Wettable sulfur
preventive_cultural_measures: Eradicate alternate host red cedar (Juniperus virginiana) within 1 km radius of orchard

primary_early_symptom: Dark green lustrous foliage, strong terminal shoot growth, crisp margins
favorable_weather_condition: Temperate moderate weather with optimal chilling hours achieved
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Foliar zinc-boron spray + mycorrhizal root inoculation
preventive_cultural_measures: Balanced winter dormant pruning; drip fertigation; pheromone mating disruption traps

primary_early_symptom: Long elliptical cigar-shaped grayish-green lesions (2-15 cm length)
favorable_weather_condition: Heavy night dew and moderate summer temperatures
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Trichoderma harzianum seed biopriming + bio-copper foliar
preventive_cultural_measures: Incorporate crop residue deep by tillage; choose disease-tolerant hybrid maize cultivars

primary_early_symptom: Small powdery cinnamon-brown pustules scattered across both leaf surfaces
favorable_weather_condition: Cool humid weather with overcast foggy daytime hours
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Ampelomyces quisqualis hyperparasitic bio-spray
preventive_cultural_measures: Plant early in the season to avoid spore blown from southern regions; monitor whorl stage

primary_early_symptom: Window-pane leaf feeding, sawdust-like frass accumulated in central whorl
favorable_weather_condition: Dry spell followed by high nighttime temperatures accelerating moth oviposition
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Nomuraea rileyi or Bacillus thuringiensis kurstaki (Bt 2 g/L)
preventive_cultural_measures: Install pheromone traps (5/acre); intercrop maize with desmodium (push-pull strategy)

primary_early_symptom: Small oval dark-brown spots with gray-white necrotic center on leaf blades
favorable_weather_condition: Nutrient-deficient sandy soils under intermittent water stress
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Pseudomonas fluorescens seed treatment (10 g/kg) + foliar
preventive_cultural_measures: Correct soil potassium, silicon, and manganese deficiencies; avoid severe field drying

primary_early_symptom: Water-soaked lesions on leaf margins rapidly turning wavy grayish-white
favorable_weather_condition: Typhoons, monsoonal storms, and deep standing floodwaters in paddies
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Cow dung filtrate (20%) + Streptomyces corchorusii spray
preventive_cultural_measures: Avoid excessive top-dressing with nitrogen fertilizer; drain excess field water

primary_early_symptom: Spindle-shaped diamond lesions with pointed ends and gray centers
favorable_weather_condition: High humidity, cloudy skies, light showers, and cool night conditions
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Foliar spray with Pseudomonas putida + Chitosan 0.1%
preventive_cultural_measures: Split nitrogen fertilizer into 3-4 split doses; maintain continuous shallow flood layer

primary_early_symptom: Round orange-brown powdery pustules randomly scattered on upper leaf surface
favorable_weather_condition: Mild winter temperatures followed by dew-laden early spring mornings
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Trichoderma viride + Kaolin clay particle film
preventive_cultural_measures: Sow recommended rust-resistant wheat varieties (e.g. DBW series); eradicate volunteer wild grasses

primary_early_symptom: Vibrant yellow pustules arranged in narrow distinct parallel linear stripes
favorable_weather_condition: Extended cool humid weather with persistent drizzle and canopy fog
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Bacillus pumilus bio-formulation + garlic clove extract spray
preventive_cultural_measures: Monitor northern sub-mountainous zones; early planting; spray immediately upon observing first stripe

primary_early_symptom: Fluffy white patches of fungal mycelium resembling talcum powder on leaves
favorable_weather_condition: Dense thick crop canopy with shade and moderate humid conditions
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Potassium silicate foliar application (2 ml/L)
preventive_cultural_measures: Optimize seeding density (100 kg/ha); avoid over-fertilizing with nitrogen

primary_early_symptom: Small circular reddish-brown leaf spots with black fruiting pycnidia in a ring
favorable_weather_condition: Rainfall events exceeding 7 hours during early shoot expansion
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Equisetum arvense (Horsetail) tea + Copper soap
preventive_cultural_measures: Remove overwintering dried mummies from trellis; practice shoot thinning to open vine microclimate

primary_early_symptom: Yellowish translucent oil-spot lesions on upper leaf surface with white felt beneath
favorable_weather_condition: The 10-10-10 rule: 10 mm rain, 10 C temp, shoots 10 cm long
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Laminarin (algal elicitor) + Copper hydroxide
preventive_cultural_measures: Tuck shoots into catch wires promptly; avoid sprinkler irrigation hitting lower vine canopy

primary_early_symptom: Tiger-stripe interveinal chlorosis and necrosis, dried wood decay inside trunk
favorable_weather_condition: High summer thermal stress on mature 10+ year old grapevines
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Trichoderma atroviride pruned wound sealant
preventive_cultural_measures: Disinfect pruning shears between vines with 70% alcohol; paint all cane cuts larger than 2 cm

primary_early_symptom: Small dark-brown angular spots delimited by leaf veinlets with water-soaking
favorable_weather_condition: Heavy monsoon showers accompanied by gusty mechanical wind injury
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens (10 g/kg)
preventive_cultural_measures: Acid delinting of cotton seed before planting; avoid inter-cultivation when leaves are wet

primary_early_symptom: Thickening of smaller veins, upward leaf curling, cup-like enations on undersides
favorable_weather_condition: Extreme hot summer conditions with huge whitefly vector migration
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Neem oil 10000 ppm (3 ml/L) + Verticillium lecanii
preventive_cultural_measures: Grow CLCuV-resistant cotton hybrids; eradicate weeds like Abutilon indicum and Parthenium

primary_early_symptom: Rosetted flowers, premature boll opening, stained lint with pink caterpillars
favorable_weather_condition: Dry cloudy weather during reproductive squaring and boll formation
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Release Trichogramma bactrae egg parasitoids (60000/acre)
preventive_cultural_measures: Install 8 pheromone delta traps/acre; destroy cotton stubble immediately after final pick

primary_early_symptom: Water-soaked lesions turning dark necrotic spots with yellow borders
favorable_weather_condition: Frequent overhead wetting and warm temperature conditions
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Copper octanoate (Bordeaux) + Bacillus mycoides isolate J
preventive_cultural_measures: Use drip irrigation; ensure seed is certified disease-free; space plants at 45x60 cm

primary_early_symptom: Circular sunken water-soaked necrotic lesions on fruit and foliage with salmon spores
favorable_weather_condition: Warm humid conditions during fruit ripening and pre-monsoon showers
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Foliar spray with Trichoderma viride + Vermiwash
preventive_cultural_measures: Stake pepper plants to prevent ground contact; harvest mature peppers promptly without bruising

primary_early_symptom: Curling of young apical leaves, sticky honeydew exudation, sooty mold growth
favorable_weather_condition: Mild pleasant weather with tender new succulent vegetative flush
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Chrysoperla carnea green lacewing larvae (2000/acre) + Neem spray
preventive_cultural_measures: Conserve beneficial predators (ladybird beetles); wash foliage with pressurized water jets

primary_early_symptom: Asymmetrical blotchy mottle chlorosis crossing leaf veins, small bitter lopsided fruits
favorable_weather_condition: Warm weather favoring Asian Citrus Psyllid (Diaphorina citri) vector
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Application of Guava interplanting + Micronutrient cocktail foliar
preventive_cultural_measures: Plant certified pathogen-free nursery trees; aggressive psyllid vector management

primary_early_symptom: Raised corky brown blister-like lesions surrounded by characteristic oily yellow halo
favorable_weather_condition: Tropical storms, wind-driven rain, and citrus leafminer feeding galleries
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Copper oxychloride 50% WP + Neem cake soil application
preventive_cultural_measures: Erect tall windbreak trees (Casuarina); control citrus leafminer during spring growth flush

primary_early_symptom: Hard spot lesions with tiny black specks and brick-red margins on fruit rind and leaf
favorable_weather_condition: Intermittent heavy rains during 4-5 months after petal fall
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Copper sulphate + Petroleum spray oil (1%)
preventive_cultural_measures: Remove decaying orchard floor leaf litter; spray preventive copper sprays from fruit set

primary_early_symptom: Uniform upright green tillers, clean leaf blades, robust panicle development
favorable_weather_condition: Optimal sunlight hours with alternate wetting and drying water regime
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Azospirillum bio-fertilizer + Azolla bio-mulch incorporation
preventive_cultural_measures: Practice Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) water management; keep bunds clean of grassy weeds

primary_early_symptom: Stippled fine yellow specks on leaf surface with delicate silken web on leaf underside
favorable_weather_condition: Hot dry dusty weather with low atmospheric moisture
organic_biocontrol_recommendation: Phytoseiulus persimilis predatory mites (5/sq. meter) + Wettable Sulfur
preventive_cultural_measures: Maintain field humidity by micro-sprinklers; avoid broad-spectrum pyrethroid overuse
